title: 第4章 不能退，也无法苟。
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

司陇在办公室内搜寻了一通，书柜内并没有什么有用信息，里面全是一些案件的档案记录和文件夹。

书柜最里层有一个金属密封的匣子，似乎需要什么解锁，但她现在根本打不开。

检查了一下自己全身，腰侧的脉冲枪，大腿后侧别着的一把精巧的匕首，还有一个随身的黑色皮质腰包。

包里有一支细杆口红，一个小镜子，一台类似小灵通一样的通讯设备，旁边还有一只无线小耳机。

她拿出那个像小灵通一样的设备，却发现处于关机状态，无法

此时包底层下面露出一个角。

掏出来是一本手掌大小的笔记本，硬壳的封面上还有些许划痕，那些划痕新旧交合，看着像战斗中留下的痕迹。

司陇粗略地翻开看了一下，也是她的字迹，里面密密麻麻的记录了许多人物和案件分析。

最新一页标星号的记录引起了她的注意。

沿海路电子仪器店店员，王启，男，32，黎明署B线线人。

而这条记录的后面紧接着三个字，待处理。

待处理是什么意思？

她迅速翻动页面，发现前面许多待处理都已被划掉，旁边更改为已处理。

这不会是某种暗线任务，需要她去杀了他吧？

【随机任务触发】

眼前适时跳出了先前看到过的系统提示框。

她疑惑地转了转头，发现提示框竟然也会跟着她的视角进行移动。

【任务难度】☆☆☆

【任务详情】芒市为永夜局管控城市之首，市内仍有许多势力错综复杂，永夜局高层怀疑更有黎明署的人隐在其中作乱。近期沿海路的奇缘KTV内有人暗中散播梦境致幻的违禁品药物，已有三名普通居民因此丧命。

【任务目标】找出违法人员，将此案完结。

【任务奖励】完成任务可获得三星系统奖励，并有机会掉落独特道具。

司陇看着提示框下方的确认和拒绝两个按钮，陷入沉思。

如果只是普通玩游戏她当然想都不想直接接受，可现在的情况不得不多考虑。

这个任务的内容能够提取的有用信息并不多，仅有一个确切的地点，沿海路。

巧合的是，她笔记本上记录的电子仪器店也是在沿海路。

随机任务是在她看到那页笔记时触发的，这其中可能会有关联。

她此时再回想起昨天看到的游戏须知，竟然什么都懂了，这个游戏从一开始就没打算瞒着。

明明白白的告诉玩家，包含血腥暴力，游戏内梦境与现实梦境同步，游戏将在入梦时开启。

还有最最最重要的那句提示，可惜当时她根本没有在意。

【游戏内死亡将无法重生，每人有且仅有一次生命，直至游戏通关。】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Si Long searched the office and found that there was no useful information in the bookcase. It was filled with file records and folders of some cases.

There is a metal-sealed box on the innermost shelf of the bookcase. It seems that it needs something to unlock it, but she can't open it at all now.

He checked his whole body and saw the pulse gun on his waist, a delicate dagger on the back of his thigh, and a black leather belt bag that he carried with him.

There is a thin stick of lipstick in the bag, a small mirror, a communication device similar to a PHS, and a small wireless earphone next to it.

She took out the PHS-like device, only to find that it was turned off and unable to

At this time, a corner is exposed under the bottom layer of the bag.

What he took out was a notebook the size of a palm. There were some scratches on the hard cover. The scratches were old and new, and they looked like traces left in battle.

Si Long flipped it through briefly and saw that it was also her handwriting. It contained densely packed records of analysis of many characters and cases.

The latest page of starred records caught her attention.

Wang Qi, male, 32, a clerk at an electronic equipment store on Haihai Road, is a B-line informant of the Dawn Department.

And this record is followed by three words, pending processing.

What does pending mean?

She quickly turned the page and found that many pending items in the front had been crossed out and changed to processed next to them.

Isn't this some kind of secret mission that requires her to kill him?

[Random task trigger]

The system prompt box that I had seen before popped up in front of my eyes.

She turned her head in confusion and found that the prompt box also moved according to her perspective.

【Task Difficulty】☆☆☆

[Mission Details] Mangshi is the first city under the control of the Yongye Bureau. There are still many complicated forces in the city. The senior officials of the Yongye Bureau suspect that there are people from the Dawn Bureau lurking among them to cause trouble.Recently, someone secretly spread contraband drugs that induce hallucinations in the Qiyuan KTV on Haihai Road. Three ordinary residents have died as a result.

[Task Objective] Find the illegal persons and complete the case.

[Task Reward] Complete the task to get three-star system rewards, and have a chance to drop unique props.

Si Long looked at the two buttons of confirm and reject under the prompt box and fell into deep thought.

If she was just playing games, of course she wouldn't want to accept it directly, but in the current situation, she had to think more about it.

There is not much useful information that can be extracted from the content of this mission. There is only one exact location, the coastal road.

Coincidentally, the electronic equipment store recorded in her notebook is also on Coastal Road.

The random mission was triggered when she saw that page of notes, and there might be a connection.

At this time, she recalled the game instructions she saw yesterday, and she understood everything. This game had no intention of hiding it from the beginning.

It is clearly told to the players that, including bloody violence, the in-game dreams are synchronized with the real dreams, and the game will start when they fall into a dream.

There was also the most important reminder, but it was a pity that she didn't pay attention at all at that time.

[If you die in the game, you will not be able to regenerate. Each person has only one life until the game is cleared.】

title_en: Chapter 4: You can’t retreat, and you can’t remain stubborn.
